parameters.content:
## Trigger

Tester uploads a screenshot
plus optional logs.

## Actions

Groq vision drafts the report.
Model id lives in one field:
qwen/qwen3.6-27b is Preview,
swap it when Groq rotates.

Auth is a referenced credential,
never an embedded key.

## Results

Bug filed in VWO with the
screenshot attached.

parameters.formDescription: Upload the screenshot. Everything else is optional, but logs and steps make the draft sharper.
